scripts.build:wasm: rm -rf pkg && wasm-pack build --scope fedibtc --target bundler --out-dir pkg --no-opt && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:ts
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && wasm-pack pack --pkg-dir pkg
scripts.publish: pnpm run build && wasm-pack publish --pkg-dir pkg --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm run build && npm publish ./pkg --dry-run --access public
